integrated_invariant_policy.interpretation: Integrated-invariant balance scaling removes the systematic fine-level collapse seen under the fixed-rate policy, but does not make Reference route validity fully monotonic or universal across the six-level ladder.

policy_endpoint_neutrality.interpretation: Where FIXED_RATE and INTEGRATED_INVARIANT both converge at the same refinement level, changing only the balance-convergence scaling does not materially change the accepted endpoint under the preregistered P2E18 stability budgets.

stability_unresolved.reason: 8-vs-16 storage endpoint delta exceeds the frozen machine-scale storage budget
stability_unresolved.head_theta_note: All head and theta stability metrics pass; 16-vs-32 storage also passes.

supported: The P2E18 refinement collapse is largely caused by applying one fixed rate-unit balance criterion across decreasing dt rather than preserving an integrated per-step balance scale.
A dimensionally integrated-invariant policy recovers fine Reference routes for nearly the complete 36-case matrix while preserving endpoints wherever a fixed-rate comparison exists.
A candidate-blind REF-HIGH construction is feasible on at least 33 of the 36 frozen performance/reference cases using the scaled policy and the already frozen 8-vs-16 and 16-vs-32 stability budgets.
not_supported: Universal Reference-route validity under integrated-invariant scaling.
Monotonic route validity at every intermediate refinement level.
REF-HIGH authority itself, because P2E19 is diagnostic by preregistration.
Any RossFast performance or equal-error claim.

next_permitted_action: Preregister a separate REF-HIGH construction using the frozen integrated-invariant balance policy and the 8/16/32 fine refinement levels. Execute all 36 cases, retain unresolved cases, and admit REF-HIGH casewise only where all three fine routes are valid and both endpoint comparisons meet the frozen P2E18 stability budgets. RossFast timing remains forbidden until that construction is persisted.
